name: LCP Accelerator
author: SACHINRAJ CP

sections.description:
LCP Accelerator is a WordPress plugin that improves Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) by optimizing page loading strategies and enhancing Core Web Vitals performance.

This plugin is designed to help websites load faster, improve user experience, and boost SEO rankings by focusing on LCP optimization.

Key Features:
– Critical CSS injection for faster above-the-fold rendering
– Defer JavaScript loading to reduce blocking time
– Smart image lazy loading
– Automatic detection and preloading of LCP images
– Lightweight and performance-focused design
– Easy to use with no complex setup
sections.installation:
1. Upload the lcp-accelerator folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Use the [lcp_status] shortcode to display optimization status.
sections.faq:
What if WebP is not supported?

If WebP is not supported by the browser, the plugin will skip optimization and continue normal loading without errors.

Does this plugin affect SEO?

Yes, improving LCP helps enhance Core Web Vitals, which can positively impact SEO rankings.
